title: How can I keep my blood glucose levels within the normal range using AAPS
body:
Hello, I am from China and the father of a 3-year-old child with type 1 diabetes. It has been two years since the diagnosis. I am currently using the AAPS (AndroidAPS) closed-loop system to manage blood glucose. However, I am encountering some difficulties with AAPS and hope you can provide some assistance. Regarding OpenAPS, which SMB features should be enabled? How should the post-meal rules and overnight hormone rules be adjusted? How should blood glucose be managed to keep it stable? I am really looking forward to your reply. Thank you.    How should SMB and temporary basal rates be used together? Which SMB features should be enabled to achieve better blood sugar control? Are there any configuration files available for reference, such as the following: a configuration file for low blood sugar protection, a configuration file for handling abnormal blood glucose data, and a daily basal profile? I’m really looking forward to your reply. My contact information: 
                  373556938qq.com
